note: Illustrative evidence case summary. It is not a signed evidence bundle and cannot itself be cryptographically verified. No customer or adoption claim. Values are constructed to demonstrate the shape of a bounded evidence case, including its gaps.
scenario: A customer disputes a paid MCP tool call to a market-data service.

established: the supplied keys validate the gateway and tool-server signatures
the tool name and argument digest are bound by the tool-server record
the payment-provider artifact is linked to the case
the result artifact supplied for review matches its bound digest
missing: evidence that every relevant retry was included
not_evaluated: correctness of the underlying service result
whether the issuer omitted another event
